subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper own the protected Cloudflare credential and become the maintainer-only production deployment authority for crawl-remote?
rationale: The patch implements a narrow fail-closed mechanism, but permanent cross-repository credential custody, environment approvers, and production deployment ownership are operational-security choices that green CI cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve central deployment
options.body: Merge the dormant workflow, verify the protected environment and approvers, and perform the first exact-SHA production dispatch under controlled observation.

options.title: Retain external deployment
options.body: Keep crawl-remote production credentials and deployment authority outside ClawSweeper and redesign or close this PR.

recommendation.title: Approve central deployment
recommendation.body: Merge the dormant workflow, verify the protected environment and approvers, and perform the first exact-SHA production dispatch under controlled observation.

likelyOwner.reason: The workflow is identity-bound to vincentkoc, whose recent merged history owns the relevant workflow authorization and token boundaries.
